name: everything
description: Search local files through Everything and return normalized markdown results with structured metadata.
promptDescription: Search local files on Windows through the bundled Everything runtime, install its permission steward, or prepare the full-disk index. [action] selects the operation and defaults to search. For search, [query] is required and may use Everything query syntax. When [scopePath] is omitted, the bundled runtime indexes accessible local drive roots; first full-disk use can require a longer index preparation. Optional [scopePath] limits results to an existing folder and uses the bundled scoped runtime; scoped searches never need authorization. Optional [instanceName] targets a named Everything instance when intentionally needed; full-disk search only supports the default instance. Optional [maxResults] controls result count. Optional [timeoutMs] controls the action timeout. Optional [maxOutputChars] controls markdown output length. Optional [description] records why the action is being run. The authorize action installs or repairs the permission steward once with administrator approval and is idempotent; call it together with the user at the computer, because the user must confirm the system elevation prompt. The index action prepares and persists the full-disk index without running a search. Full-disk actions (search without [scopePath], and index) fail fast while the permission steward is not healthy and ask to authorize first; the recommended flow is authorize, then index, then search. The tool ships with Everything.exe and es.exe. Configure [esPath] or EVERYTHING_ES_PATH only when you intentionally want to use an external Everything CLI instead of the bundled CLI. The bundled runtime instance closes right after the action unless the user enabled keep-alive, in which case it stays running for the configured idle period. Search returns normalized markdown plus metadata including provider, query, resultsCount, scopeMode, scopePath, scopePaths, instanceName, durationMs, truncated, executableSource, and runtimeSource; index returns full-disk scope, instance name, duration, and per-drive visible entry counts. The permission steward is a system service installed in the protected program installation area and serves the full-disk instance only.

esPath.title: Everything CLI 路径
esPath.description: 明确覆盖自带 Everything CLI 时使用的 es.exe 绝对路径；通常不用填写，也可通过 EVERYTHING_ES_PATH 环境变量提供。

instanceName.title: 默认实例名
instanceName.description: 模型未指定 instanceName 时使用的 Everything 实例名；留空表示工具专属默认实例。

scopePath.title: 默认搜索范围
scopePath.description: 模型未指定 scopePath 时使用的默认文件夹范围；留空表示通过工具自带本体搜索可用盘符，相对路径基于 e-b 主机工作目录。

maxResults.title: 默认结果数量
maxResults.description: 模型未指定 maxResults 时使用的结果数量。

maxOutputChars.title: 默认最大输出字符数
maxOutputChars.description: 模型未指定 maxOutputChars 时使用的最大 Markdown 输出字符数。

keepAliveEnabled.title: 搜索完成后保持运行
keepAliveEnabled.description: 开启后搜索完成时不会立即关闭工具专属的 Everything 实例，而是保持运行一段时间供连续搜索复用；关闭（默认）时搜索结果返回后实例立即关闭。

keepAliveSeconds.title: 保持运行秒数
keepAliveSeconds.description: keepAliveEnabled 开启时生效：最后一次搜索后 Everything 实例保持运行的秒数，超时后自动关闭；关闭 keepAliveEnabled 时该值保留不变。

action.description: Action to perform. Defaults to search. authorize installs or repairs the permission steward with one administrator approval; index prepares and persists the full-disk index. authorize and index accept no search-only arguments.

query.description: Required for the search action. Everything search query. Everything query syntax is supported.

scopePath.description: Optional for the search action: an existing folder used to limit the otherwise full-disk search. Relative paths resolve from the e-b host working directory. Scoped searches never need authorization.

instanceName.description: Optional Everything instance name for search. Omit for the default instance; full-disk search only supports the default instance.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum markdown output characters for search.

description.description: Short human-readable reason for running the action.
